name: AL Language XApp F
brief: Cross-app fixture F: one report extension of a report of cross-app fixture A; depends on A only.
description: Holds one report extension of a report of cross-app fixture A (al-runner issue 7358, the order rule of report extensions from apps with no dependency path between them). Depends on cross-app fixture A only; no app depends on it. The app id, name and publisher are fixed on purpose: with B and D they decide the candidate orders of the probe (tests/al-language-xapp-a/R7358XaOrderRule.al). Do not change them.
